career.title: Career
career.lead: Rank, reputation, track record and your own money.
career.atRank: Current · {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}
career.topNote: You run a fund under your own name. There is no higher rank.
career.need.deals: {count, plural, one {# deal closed} other {# deals closed}}
career.need.months: {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} at current rank
career.need.record: {count, plural, one {# deal} other {# deals}} + fund TVPI {tvpi}+
career.need.termNow: {months, plural, =0 {Reached} one {# month left} other {# months left}}
career.founderNote: With enough reputation at the end of the fund term, you raise the next fund under your own name.
career.fire.fund: Below Partner when the fund ends under {tvpi} (set by difficulty)
career.reputationNote: The higher your reputation, the smaller each gain. Losses stay the same size.
career.carryNote: Carry share {share}. Accrued carry is at today's marks and is paid at the end of the fund term.
career.partner.0.trait: Looks at downside, cash and covenants first.
career.partner.1.trait: Plants and working capital. Wants operational diligence.
career.partner.2.trait: Quality of revenue. Does not buy multiple-expansion stories.
career.partner.3.trait: Looks at downside and legal exposure.
career.partner.4.trait: Wants a 100-day plan. Opposes hidden restructuring.
career.partner.5.trait: Watches fund concentration and the firm's reputation.
career.attentionNote: Monthly attention is now {max, number, ::integer}. Difficulty and team add to the base for your rank.
career.principalNote: From Principal you can open deals outside the US.
career.objectives.none: The chair sets objectives in January.
career.objectives.stakes: Reviewed in December. Each one met: reputation +{up, number, ::integer} and a bonus. Each one missed: reputation −{down, number, ::integer}.
career.team.note: Each associate adds +1 monthly attention and costs {cost} a year from personal wealth.
career.team.lockedNote: You build a team once you have your own firm. Each associate adds +1 monthly attention for {cost} a year.
career.trust.rule: At trust {pass, number, ::integer} or above, that partner's hold counts as a vote for; at {block, number, ::integer} or below, as a vote against.
